title: Minke whale passive acoustic annotation dataset
description: 82,652 manually annotated clips from 50 passive acoustic deployments across the UK and USA (2006-2023). Labels: minke whale (MW), humpback whale boings (HB), humpback whale knocks (HK), and non-biological noise (NN). Audio formats: WAV and AIF. Annotations stored as a single NetCDF file compatible with ecosound.
